company.name: ANYbotics
company.shortDescription: ANYbotics is a robotics company that offers autonomous robotic inspection solutions for industrial operations.
company.description: ANYbotics offers autonomous robotic inspection solutions for industrial operations. The company develops four-legged robots like ANYmal and ANYmal X that navigate complex, hazardous environments to perform data collection, routine inspection, and monitoring tasks. Their systems generate data insights to help identify issues such as leaks or equipment wear, and support decision-making around maintenance and safety. ANYbotics serves sectors including utilities, mining, chemicals, oil & gas, and transportation. The focus rests on reducing risk, improving operational consistency, and allowing inspections in areas difficult or unsafe for personnel.

aiResearchSummary.text: ANYbotics is engaged in developing methods to reduce the risk of explosion of a battery for a mobile robot, focusing on battery housing, environmental sensors, and safety units. Additionally, they are researching a robot foot for legged robots, including a solid body with a surface and an attachment section for mounting. These activities highlight their focus on mobile robot safety and the mechanical design of legged robots.
